title: GET /covers embeds every stored cover image in one unbounded response

evidence.quote: covers=[_manual_cover_to_read(cover, settings) for cover in covers]

reasoning: The list endpoint selects every ManualCover row and converts each one into a response object that synchronously reads the whole image file and base64-embeds it as preview_data_url. Uploaded covers are normalized, but the number of covers is not bounded or paginated, so the endpoint's memory, CPU, event-loop blocking time, and response size grow linearly with all historical uploads. An authenticated user repeatedly uploading covers can make the settings list slow or very large even though the UI only needs preview-sized images.
recommendation: Return bounded preview data instead of full stored cover bytes for every row. For example, generate/store a small thumbnail during upload and embed only that thumbnail in GET /covers, and add pagination or a maximum result count if historical cover counts can grow without limit.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: The existing flow test uploads two tiny images and only asserts that the list returns at least two covers, so it does not exercise response size, many-cover behavior, or large normalized cover payloads.
suggestedRegressionTest: Seed several ManualCover rows with large normalized JPEG files and assert GET /api/config/covers either returns thumbnail-sized preview_data_url values or enforces the intended page/limit rather than embedding every full-size cover.
minimumFixScope: Update app/api/config.py's cover serialization/listing path and, if thumbnails are used, the upload path that creates cover files; add focused API coverage for the chosen bound.
